source.lookup_contract: MaterialRegistry.get(record.name): exact Unicode casefold over canonical names and aliases

promotion_boundary: A RESOLVED entry authorizes only exact label-to-existing-record lookup.
It does not authorize or revise chemistry, physical properties, ODT, OAV, IFRA, natural composition, stock quantity, formula dose, or database authority.
An UNKNOWN entry must remain unresolved until direct supplier-product or equivalent identity evidence is recorded.

entries.decision_basis: The inventory explicitly identifies a 1% stock of Hexyl Acetate and notes that the 10% stock already exists; dilution is stock metadata.
The inventory explicitly identifies a 10% v/v stock of Helional and separately records neat Helional; dilution is stock metadata.
The inventory expands PADMA as Phenylacetaldehyde Dimethyl Acetal, matching the dedicated PADMA data-spine record.
The label names Cinnamyl alcohol directly; 50% in DPG is stock preparation metadata.
The p- prefix and PCME expansion identify Para-Cresyl Methyl Ether; the trailing 10% inventory preparation is stock metadata.
The data spine contains Tuberlia Base but no direct supplier-product, lot, CAS, or other identity evidence proves that Tuberose Base is the same trade base. Similar odor naming is insufficient.
EO expands to essential oil, and the inventory identifies Cupressus sempervirens rather than Cypress Absolute.
EO expands to essential oil, and the inventory identifies Myrocarpus fastigiatus with 50% w/w DPG as stock metadata.
The inventory explicitly identifies a 10% stock of Anisaldehyde and notes that neat Anisaldehyde already exists.
The inventory explicitly identifies a 1% stock of Ethyl Maltol and separately records a 10% stock; dilution is stock metadata.
